text: dsh-compass 是面向 DSH 工具系统的代码库地图与导航插件，注册 codebase_map 和 code_tour 两个工具。它可扫描本地项目并返回文件清单、Node 包信息和候选入口，也能按路径关键词查找源码中的声明行，帮助 agent 快速了解仓库结构、定位相关代码。扫描和导航都有数量上限，并可用 revision 检查地图是否过期。适合需要在 DSH 会话中浏览和定位本机项目代码的开发者。源码未读取外部 API 或密钥配置。

dsh-compass adds two DSH tools: codebase_map lists files, Node package details, and candidate entry points in a local project; code_tour finds declaration lines in source files matching a path keyword. Bounded scans and revision checks help agents navigate projects and detect when a map has changed.
想让 DSH 帮我快速列出项目文件和入口文件
有没有工具可以按关键词找到仓库里相关源码的声明位置？
Map a local codebase and show its packages and candidate entry points.
dsh-compass 的功能「生成代码库地图」：调用 codebase_map 后扫描当前 agent 的工作目录，返回文件清单、Node 包脚本与依赖名称、候选入口和 revision；扫描规模受限，超出时会标记 truncated。
dsh-compass 的功能「按路径关键词浏览源码声明」：调用 code_tour 并提供 topic，在匹配路径的源码文件中列出识别到的声明行及行号；可带 expectedRevision 检查地图是否已变化。

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · dsh-compass：DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 plugin. Node >=24; developed and tested locally with Node 26 / TypeScript 5.9.3. Release CI is configured for Node 24; that CI run is separate from local verification.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Install from a GitHub Release：After a release is published, install its built archive into your DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile headless add https://github.com/LIghtJUNction/dsh-compass/releases/download/v0.1.0/lightjunction-dsh-compass-0.1.0.tgz
dsh headless --dump-config
```

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Install from a GitHub Release：The release URL is the expected v0.1.0 asset location, not a claim that it has already been published. Use the archive and SHA256SUMS attached to the same GitHub Release. The package includes a DSH bundle patch and built JavaScript; no Pi dependency is needed. Restart DSH after installation. Substitute your existing profile for `headless` if needed.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Configuration：The default bundle config is `{}`: each tool uses the invoking agent's working directory. A host call without an agent requires an explicit `root`. To pin a host-local workspace, add an override in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-compass
  config:
    root: /absolute/local/project
```

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Configuration：The root must already exist. It is interpreted on the DSH host, using Node filesystem APIs. A remote DSH world or sandbox does not redirect these operations: only enable this plugin for a host-local project. This is not a remote-world adapter or a security sandbox.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Tools and examples：Ask DSH: “Map this repository, then show a tour of files under src.” Package metadata reports Node package names, scripts, and dependency names; scripts are never run. Candidate entry points include index/main/app/server files and Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml and go.mod. Candidates are heuristics, not proven executable entry points.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Limits and behavior：Every call scans fresh host-local files. Hidden entries, symlinks, node_modules, dist, build, target, coverage and vendor directories are skipped. Scans stop at 1,000 files, 4,000 visited entries, or directory depth eight and report truncation. This is not a Git-ignore parser. Malformed/unreadable package.json fails the operation instead of silently inventing package data. Reads reject traversal and symlink ancestors and are bounded to 256 KiB per file.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Limits and behavior：Map revisions fingerprint file paths, size, mtime/ctime and package.json text; they are not a content hash of every source file or an atomic filesystem snapshot. A tour verifies the map again after reading and asks for retry if it changed. It visits at most 20 matching files, returning up to 15 declaration lines per file (240 characters per line), and marks excess candidate files as truncated. Invalid UTF-8, binary, oversized or unreadable selected files fail explicitly.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Limits and behavior：Supported declaration heuristics cover common JS/TS, Python, Rust, Go, Java and C-family extensions. This is not an AST index, reference search, import graph or compiler. Tours do not infer architecture. There is no persistent cache, automatic prompt injection, Pi TUI onboarding menu, framework/convention detection or semantic tour generation. Concurrent reads are supported; disposal aborts/drains work and unregisters tools.

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Filesystem boundary and verification：Path checks reject ordinary symlink redirection; regular-file opens use no-follow flags and inode checks, bounded reads and cancellation. These checks are not a sandbox against a malicious process concurrently replacing ancestor directories; use a trusted local workspace. Linux/macOS-style filesystem semantics are the intended target; Windows behavior has not been verified.

```sh
npm run check
```

@lightjunction/dsh-compass README · Filesystem boundary and verification：The suite uses real Cordis, DSH ToolRuntime, agent-loop and an offline scripted model; it verifies actual model tool dispatch and results in the following model request, plus limits, revision/path checks, cancellation and unregistration. It requires no live model credentials. `check` includes TypeScript checks for source/tests, behavior tests and a build. See [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md) for pinned source and migration differences and [NOTICE](NOTICE) for upstream MIT attribution.
